name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Builder
description: Builds MiniMax H3 prompts. Base modes write the three-field schema with integrated_multimodal_description; a reference-mode switch reveals all Ref2VA options and writes the six-section format. Combined cast and subjects list, ordered beats with intra-shot timing, per-shot lens and rig, colour grading, and audio references for voice, ambience and score.
author: JedsDeadBaby
